summary.intent: Coordinate several background workers that resolve merge conflicts and verify CI on open PRs (#323, #327, #347/#343, #367/#348/#349) in the caliper repo, and report their final state.
summary.outcome: The #323/#327 worker merged origin/main into both PRs and pushed them. #323 is fully green with 0 open findings. #327 was still waiting on CI and Entire Gates when the session ended, and the other two workers were still running. The same worker report arrived three times and was treated as a duplicate each time.

repo: Branches can be checked out in other worktrees (m323 was), so the worker used a differently named local branch (mc323) and pushed it with `git push origin mc323:measure/storybook-accuracy-headline`.

The lint gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`. A full clean-room verification uses a fresh worktree in /tmp, then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`, then Rust nextest, oracle vitest, and Python unittest.

Entire Gates is a CI check that gates findings. Findings are listed with `entire trail finding list <trail> --project gh/orin-dx --freshness current --status open --json`, and should be re-listed only after Entire Gates completes.
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION is 29 on main and on PR 327, so there was no cache-version conflict to resolve.
Main added a shared helper `in_node_modules` in crates/core/src/dependency_types.rs, and it is now the only place that does the `contains("/node_modules/")` check.

code.finding: In the `CollapseInheritedProps::All` arm of `collapses()`, the conflict was resolved as `large && !crate::dependency_types::in_node_modules(file.as_str())`. It keeps PR 327's dependency/large logic and uses main's helper.

Main's new test `collapsing_all_leaves_a_node_modules_source_alone_whichever_separator_the_path_uses` called the old `collapses` signature. This was a semantic break the merge did not flag, and it was fixed with `ctx.collapses(Utf8Path::new(file), "Props", 31, 1, &state)`.
Both sides added an import at the same spot (`import headline` and `import schema_version`), and the conflict was resolved by keeping both.
The line cited apps/oracle/src/layer-only.ts and a 'Layer-only props' section that exist on neither main nor the PR branch. It was reworded to say they live on the `measure/layer-only-props` branch.

workflow: A clean merge does not guarantee a compiling tree. Main's new tests can call a signature that the PR changed, and only the lint/compile gate catches it.
Subagent hand-backs and completion notifications can arrive repeatedly with identical content. Treat them as duplicates and check live state with `gh` rather than re-reading the report.
Before each push, the worker confirmed the PR was still OPEN with `gh pr view --json state` and used only plain pushes.
CI runs can sit queued for a long time before starting, so a report can end with checks still pending.

friction: The #323/#327 worker's final report and task notification were delivered three times with identical content, which created noise.
CI for PR 327 sat queued for a long time, so the worker stopped waiting before the checks finished.
The merge for PR 327 compiled cleanly in the textual sense but broke a test, and that was only caught by `just lint`.
open_items: Wait for PR 327's pending checks to finish: Lint, Test / Rust, Node 26 TypeScript, Vite plugin, Coverage, the npm and pnpm installs, SemVer, Changesets, and Entire Gates.
Re-run `entire trail finding list caliper/124 --project gh/orin-dx --freshness current --status open --json` once Entire Gates completes, to confirm the docs/measurement.md finding is resolved.
The #347/#343 worker and the #367/#348/#349 worker are still running and their results are not yet collected.
The layer-only classifier and its write-up exist only on the `measure/layer-only-props` branch, and docs/measurement.md now says so.
